name: smart-campus-ai
description: SmartCampus AI — The Future of Intelligent Education

scripts.dev:all: (npm run docker:dev || echo "Docker not running or not found. Starting servers locally...") && npx concurrently --kill-others --names "API,WEB,AI" --prefix-colors "blue,green,yellow" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.dev:full: (npm run docker:dev || echo "Docker not running") && npx concurrently --kill-others --names "API,WEB,AI" --prefix-colors "blue,green,yellow" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.build: cd apps/api && npm run build && cd ../web && npm run build
scripts.lint: cd apps/api && npm run lint && cd ../web && npm run lint
scripts.typecheck: cd apps/api && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../web && npx tsc --noEmit
